title: Deewangee
desc: Shekhar hides a runaway girl for a reward, but ends up marrying her. Everything falls apart when a friend leaves him stolen diamonds right before being murdered.

title: Kasme Vaade
desc: Raju, guilt-ridden over his brother's death, meets Amit's lookalike, Shankar, and unknowingly becomes entangled in a deeper mystery, making amends while facing unsettling truths.

title: Pitaah
desc: Rudra, a poor labourer in a village ruled by the ruthless Thakur Avadh Narayan Singh, seeks justice after the Thakur's sons rape his minor daughter-vowing to hold them accountable.

title: Laadla
desc: Headstrong factory owner Sheetal marries Raju, the union leader, intending to crush his spirit and teach him a lesson, but their clash soon turns into a battle of wills.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: Ram Lakhan
desc: Ram, a righteous cop, and Lakhan, his carefree brother, unite for revenge after discovering their father was murdered by two cunning criminals. Justice, drama, and brotherhood drive their journey.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers dream of wealth by investing in buildings. Kabir cons them, leaving them broke. Determined, they set out to avenge their humiliation and reclaim dignity.

title: Siya
desc: Siya, a teenage rape survivor, bravely fights for justice against powerful men. Despite fear and danger, she refuses to stay silent and takes on the system.

title: Socha Na Tha
desc: Viren cant imagine having an arranged marriage. His parents want him to meet Aditi. They refuse to get married but stay friends. Will Cupid strike and change their minds?

title: Pyar Jhukta Nahin
desc: Ajay and Preeti marry despite her parents' disapproval. Bhanu, her father, interferes constantly, creating troubles and trying to separate them, testing their love and determination to stay together.

title: Dhadak
desc: Madhu and Parthavi fall in love despite social differences. Families oppose them, forcing the couple to elope, while her father and brother chase relentlessly, testing their bond.

title: Kaho Naa Pyar Hai
desc: After Rohit's mysterious death, Sonia relocates to New Zealand to heal. There, she meets Raj-Rohit's lookalike-who helps her uncover the truth behind Rohit's murder.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.

title: Saagar
desc: Raja secretly loves Mona, but she loves Ravi. Ravi's grandmother disapproves, forcing Mona to choose between love and family, leaving Raja heartbroken yet hopeful.

title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Ayassh Dil
desc: Malay is a successful journalist, but his personal life spins out of control when he gets romantically involved with several women despite being married.
